description: Reject an exchange-generated order proposal related to a previously advertised sales offer.
conditions: An offer was posted through adjust_sales_demand, but the returned proposal does not match it.
trade_decision_card.review_queue contains a real proposal awaiting a decision, or the department's proposals_list contains a pending proposal.
Inventory, delivery timing, or available commitment capacity cannot cover the proposed order.
parameter_constraints: proposal_id must identify an existing proposal. Prefer trade_decision_card.review_queue; consult the department's proposals_list only if the decision card does not include it.
When creating action.json from this template, action_param must contain exactly the fields listed in required_parameters, with none added or omitted.
constraints: Do not reject solely because proposal.quantity exceeds current on_hand. Prioritize rejection only when confirmed or stale backlog is high, due_risk is severe, pricing_gap is materially unfavorable, or supply still cannot be committed by the future delivery date.
Prioritize rejection when trade_decision_card.review_queue recommends reject_proposal_order or reason_codes show materially unfavorable due_risk, inventory_conflict, or pricing_gap.
